claim: Central Province accounted for 10.7% of Sri Lanka's nominal GDP in 2024, third behind Western Province (42.4%) and North Western Province (11.5%).

metric.denominator: Sri Lanka nominal GDP by province
metric.basis: Central Bank of Sri Lanka provincial gross domestic product series, published 2025-12-22
metric.source_definition: provincial nominal GDP share; not Kandy-city GDP

bounded_by: Central Province includes areas outside Kandy city; the metric cannot be used as a city GDP estimate.
notes: Weakens any unqualified claim that Kandy is the country's second economic centre while using the latest published PGDP release.
